note: FROZEN before any backtest. Any change requires a new id and a new pre-registration; the runner refuses a config whose SHA-256 differs from PREREGISTRATION.md.

account.sleeves: one third of REALIZED equity per asset (wallet cash + posted collateral; unrealized PnL is never used as collateral); an asset without data keeps its third in cash

leverageNote: 1x is not executable on Jupiter (minimum 1.1x), so the 1x research level is run as 1.1x. The level L caps a sleeve's notional at L x sleeve equity; the POSITION's own leverage = notional / posted collateral and never goes below 1.1x.

sizing.rule: exposure = signal x L x min(1, volRefAnnual / sigma30), sigma30 = annualised stdev of daily close-to-close log returns over the last 30 days

A.name: Donchian Trend Ensemble
A.rule: per channel n (in 4h bars = days x 6): long when close > highest high of the previous n bars; exit long when close < lowest low of the previous n x 0.5 bars; long_short adds the mirror short (close < lowest low of n -> short; exit when close > highest high of n x 0.5). Signal = mean of the 4 channel states, in [-1, 1] (long_flat: [0, 1])

B.name: Time-Series Momentum
B.rule: every 5 days from the anchor, at 00:00 UTC: r = close / close 28 days earlier - 1 (daily closes). long_flat: signal 1 if r > 0 else 0. long_short: +1 if r > 0, -1 if r < 0, 0 if r = 0. Held until the next 5-day decision

riskManager.protectiveStop: a stop-loss (Jupiter TP/SL trigger) at half the distance from entry to the liquidation price; no take-profit (neither strategy defines one)
riskManager.duplicateGuard: one idempotency key per (strategy, asset, decision time); a request is never re-sent while one is pending
riskManager.noMartingale: size comes only from the sizing rule on realized equity; never increased after a loss

costs.source: fees, max leverage (500x liquidation limit), price-impact scalars and current hourly borrow rates read from the Jupiter Perps custody accounts on-chain (snapshot 2026-11-25, slot 473594808); historical borrow rates are UNKNOWN and assumed equal to today's (base) or double (conservative)

execution.decisionAt: close of the 4h bar (A) or 00:00 UTC (B)
execution.fillAt: open of the next 1h bar x (1 +/- delaySlip) (keeper request path)
execution.missed: with probability missProb a request expires and is retried at the next 1h bar
execution.intrabar: each 1h bar: high assumed before low for the drawdown; for an open position the ADVERSE extreme is checked first: stop (may fail with stopFailProb, retried next bar), then liquidation at the liquidation price (all remaining collateral lost)

windowsNote: DEV windows follow the earlier futures research (2017-01 / 2018-04 / 2022-01 to 2026-09); DEV-1 starts 2017-09 because Binance data start 2017-08-17 and A needs 80 days of warm-up. ALL DEV data were used by earlier price-based rounds (REUSED). HOLDOUT (2026-10-01..2026-11-23) has never been used by any test; it is sealed until the DEV results are committed, is ~8 weeks long, and can only veto, never qualify.

selection.Q1: conservative costs, DEV-2 and DEV-3: maximum drawdown < 15 % (standing requirement) and the $75 shutdown never reached
selection.Q2: conservative costs: CAGR > 7.4 %/yr (S3-25, 2018-04..2026-09) in DEV-2 and > 0 in DEV-3
selection.Q3: conservative costs: zero liquidations in DEV-1, DEV-2, DEV-3
selection.Q4: conservative costs, DEV-2: probability of reaching -25 % from any start day within 91 days < 5 %
selection.Q5: conservative costs, DEV-2: net positive on at least 2 of the 3 assets run alone
selection.Q6: HOLDOUT (run once, after the DEV results are committed): no $75 shutdown and drawdown < 15 % (veto only)
selection.pick: among candidates passing Q1-Q5 (and not vetoed by Q6), the highest DEV-2 conservative CAGR; otherwise NONE QUALIFIES

amendments.change: added the swap fee for LONG positions funded with USDC (Jupiter long collateral is held in the asset token, so USDC is swapped in on open and out on close): pool swapBps = 10 (read on-chain) plus a weight-dependent tax of up to 100 bps; base 10 bps, conservative 30 bps per swap, charged on the collateral swapped
